audit_campaign: TOTAL MECHANISM AUDIT AND AUTONOMOUS REPAIR

method.test_selection: parsed import edges (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom, plus fastprompter.* string literals); no filename globs
method.status_rule: VERIFIED requires every module on disk, every module with an importing test, a non-zero collected count, a test file list the recorded run actually covers, and zero failing cases in that run
method.planes: UNIT/GUI/PERSISTENCE/RECOVERY/WINDOWS classified lexically from the owning test files; a plane is EXERCISED only when a marker appears in the source of a test that imports the domain's modules
method.acceptance: declared in docs/audit/ACCEPTANCE.json and validated here; a VISUAL claim needs a real image capture and an ACCEPTED claim needs exact case ids from the recorded run
method.reverify: a module whose sha256 differs from the one stamped at --record time forces REVERIFY_REQUIRED
